overview: Billy Chapman, who was traumatized by his parents' Christmas Eve murder, then brutalized by sadistic orphanage nuns, grows up to dress as jolly St. Nick for a yuletide rampage to punish the naughty.
tagline: He knows when you've been naughty.
title: Silent Night, Deadly Night

release_dates.note: VHS (Int'l Video Entertainment, published May 1986 according to Billboard)
